description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat luksoze te zones se TEG, dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 61.5 m2.
Apartamenti shitet i investuar perfshire mobilimin si ne foto.
Objekti eshte i termoizoluar me sistem kapote dhe fasade me pllaka terrakote te cilesise me te larte. Dritaret termoizoluese jane me xham triplex dhe kane shtrirje te gjatesise deri ne dysheme,perfshire grila elektrike.
Objekti ka akses te menjehershem ne rruget e shpejtesise perreth, si dhe ndodhet fare prane qendres tregtare TEG.
Prona disponon certifikate pronesie!
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the luxurious residences of the TEG area, and has a total area of ​​61.5 m2. The apartment is sold invested, including the furniture as in the photo. The building is thermally insulated with a hood system and a facade with terracotta tiles of the highest quality. The thermally insulating windows are triplex glass and extend to the floor, including electric shutters. The facility has immediate access to the surrounding expressways, as well as being located very close to the TEG shopping center. The property has ownership certificates!
